task: Add an include_tool_outputs query param to the conversation export endpoint so DOCX/PDF export can toggle between a concise variant (no tool outputs) and today's full variant.

key_reasoning.reason: MessageExporter.__init__ and DocumentBuilder are shared by the full-conversation export path (in scope) and the per-message export path (explicitly out of scope); the new flag must thread through this shared constructor without changing per-message behavior — that shared-utility coupling, not just router+service call count, drives the scope.

The filtering primitive (ExportUtils.should_include_thought) already exists and is unit-tested, but the pdf/docx branch of the router has zero existing test coverage today, and no existing test template asserts structural formatting preservation (headings/lists/tables/links/code blocks) across the concise/full x pdf/docx variant matrix the acceptance criteria imply.

Whether the existing author-name-substring heuristic behind export_full_thought=False actually matches the ticket's 'prompts + assistant responses only, no tool outputs' definition is flagged in the technical analysis as an open design decision, not a settled research finding.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: change touches MessageExporter/DocumentBuilder, a constructor shared by the full-conversation export path (in scope) and the per-message export path (explicitly out of scope per the frontend spec), requiring careful scoping to avoid regressing the untouched path.

Technical Risk bumped from S to M: acceptance criteria require formatting preservation across concise/full and PDF/DOCX variants, and no existing structural-assertion test template covers that variant matrix.
